in_sanskrit.name: शुशंत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who sustains, supports, or endures. The one who is free from old age, death, and decay.

in_hindi.name: सुशान्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: Steady, calm, and unchanging at the end.

in_marathi.name: Sushant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sushant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rooted in the Sanskrit language, Sushant is derived from the words ‘shush’ meaning ‘quiet’ and ‘asan’ meaning ‘seated’. This name symbolizes a steadfast and calm individual who is firmly rooted in their beliefs and values. In Hindu mythology, Sushant is also the name of a sage and a celestial being, emphasizing the spiritual and philosophical connection to this name.
